node.title: Ecosystem Awareness — Integrated Foundational Theory of Bounded Uncertainty and Ecosystem Change
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. Foundational problem: two related, non-identical origins · 1.0 Current research-hypothesis extension: causal priority and computational economy (adopted 24 October 2026) · 1.1 Residual indeterminacy and the epistemic posture.

relations: The integrated Foundation separates bounded representation from loss of qualification as conditions change; the two problems interact without being identical.
Es una formulación del corpus y sus hipótesis, no aceptación científica externa.
